purpose: Describe distance-weighted consumption by whole-drive average-speed band, with explicit qualification, coverage, monthly context and sampled drive evidence.
primaryGoal: Identify the lowest-consumption qualified observed band for the workspace vehicle and date window, understand evidence limits, and inspect/export the supporting data without mistaking association for a recommended road speed or causal savings.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle/window participate in the query key; vehicle enables query; safeArray selects rows; FAST staleTime and inherited retry policy remain. AbortSignal reaches request. One bounded request, not full-history pagination.
dataSources.limits: Router and frontend request inspected; backend filtering, ordering, completeness, payload and runtime were not exercised.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle selection is shared; range uses speed-sweetspot.range and all-time default. Page sends calendar start/end strings rather than the available precise instants. No competing page date or vehicle picker.
dataSources.limits: Mounted route is source-confirmed only. Scope behavior in the browser is unverified.

dataSources.owner: Existing shared data-trust adapter / api dataState
dataSources.behavior: Historical source provenance; initial loading and fatalError become section state. Page hasData/isSuccess guards brief resolution and isRefreshBlocked identifies retained content. Refresh warning remains beside evidence.
dataSources.limits: Underlying deriveDataState implementation was not read; source integration, not executed state acceptance.

dataSources.behavior: Finite positive measured Wh and average m/s, >=2000m and >=300s define eligibility. Stable half-open 10km/h conceptual buckets require >=3 eligible drives to qualify. Consumption uses summed energy/distance; lowest qualified consumption wins with lower-speed tie-break. Overall gap is signed descriptive evidence. UTC calendar months use aggregate distance/duration speed; invalid dates remain in non-calendar aggregates. Deterministic chronological scatter sample caps at 300, including endpoints. All eligible returned drives still feed aggregates; 1000 returned rows mark possible history truncation.

dataSources.owner: Existing useUnits, SI converters and number formatting; DrivingSummaryBrief metric adapter
dataSources.behavior: Raw Drive m, s, m/s and Wh remain unchanged. Model-local km/h bucket semantics and Wh/km ratios are explicit. Unit/locale/precision conversion happens in presentation; missing values use em dash. Month labels use UTC. Brief specialist formatters retain band bounds, signed percentage and weighted consumption.

issues.rule: MDC-026 unknown is not successful measured zero
issues.detail: Scatter badge says All eligible points from empty provisional summary while query is initial/fatal; coverage badge shows 0 qualified and monthly badge 0 observed months similarly. These chart action badges are not gated by source resolution, unlike brief badges.
issues.fix: Pass resolved/source state to chart actions and suppress provisional result badges or use localized pending/unavailable state. Retain measured zero after successful resolution and the distinct sampled/complete label.

visualIssues.detail: Decorative list icon uses fixed text-purple-300 rather than theme-neutral icon tokens. Chart colors come from existing shared palette with restrained reference-area opacity; no neon/glow or fixed-white page styling found by scoped source scan.
visualIssues.fix: Use an existing neutral semantic icon token unless purple communicates a domain meaning. Preserve saved chart palette choices, winner annotation, dashed unqualified series and qualification opacity.

architectureIssues.detail: Page consumes start/end calendar keys and passes them to useDrives. useRangeState.ts:113-122,656-669 exposes precise rolling or timezone calendar instants; useDriving.ts:95-96 documents endInstantExclusive. Those precise bounds are not forwarded by this caller. Backend interpretation of the date strings and actual range correctness were not inspected or exercised.
architectureIssues.fix: Use startInstant/endInstantExclusive for data-hook bounds while retaining calendar start/end for display labels, shared persistKey/default and server filtering. Verify backend bounds before claiming full-range correctness; do not add a local picker.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-002 / MDC-034 single shared chart controller
architectureIssues.detail: Curve nests EmbeddedChart chartKey=consumption-speed inside outer speed-sweet-spot-curve, and scatter nests drive-evidence inside speed-sweet-spot-drive-evidence. Each frame supplies its own hidden-series controller; plot combines both via OR. Curve also has overlapping four-column inner and six-column outer alternatives. Nested source ownership is confirmed; actual interaction failure is not.
architectureIssues.fix: Integrate through existing ChartContainer/EmbeddedChart contract with one deliberate controller per plot, retaining both historical saved legend identities until equivalence/migration is verified, all outer data columns, annotations and exports. Do not remove accessibility alternatives or series to reduce chrome.
